newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST WEST INDIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST WEST INDIES.

text.p: Australia captain Mark Taylor won the toss and elected to bat against West Indies in a World Series limited overs match at the Gabba on Sunday.
Australia were without fast bowler Glenn McGrath because of swelling on his left knee after he was hit by a delivery during batting practice on Saturday.
McGrath was replaced by fellow fast bowler Anthony Stuart, who is making his international debut.
Shivnarine Chanderpaul returned to West Indies' middle order after missing his side's last match because of an infection in his mouth.
Australia, West Indies and Pakistan are locked together on four points from as many games in the triangular competition.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Stuart Law, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Greg Blewett, Tom Moody, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Andrew Bichel, Anthony Stuart, Matthew Hayden (12th man).

West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Junior Murray, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Jimmy Adams, Robert Samuels, Nixon McLean, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Courtney Walsh (captain), Adrian Griffith (12th man)
